images.caption: Battlements, Lindisfarne Castle, Holy Island, Northumberland Looking across the battlements in a south easterly direction.  Bamburgh Castle can be seen on the horizon to the right of the people, with the Farne Islands between the group of three people and the person on their own.  We are told to take care of the water drain channel in the centre.
